scope: Confederate A E marching only, exact v13 source; limited local opt-in preview acceptance
verdict: PASS for exact-source local opt-in preview with expressive knee height, contact-depth and ground variation limits recorded

appearance.kit: Gray kepi-like cap/jacket, tan trousers, brown boots, compact beige roll across upper back, brown straps, dark hip pouches and round tan canteen appear in all four cells.
appearance.referenceContinuity: Broad ConfA kit identity is recognizable against retained NE/NW; cap and compact roll interpretation differ in profile. Exact face and skeleton identity uncertified.

bearingAndGrip.bearing: Native body, head and toes face image right in every cell.
bearingAndGrip.grip: Two hands plausibly contact upright diagonal rifle stock/fore-end throughout.
bearingAndGrip.limits: Far hand, fingers and concealed pelvis partly occluded; no physical anatomy or historical drill certification.

cells.name: TL contact
cells.observation: Wide contact with near visible leg trailing left and far leg leading right.

cells.name: TR passing
cells.observation: Distinct near knee lifted forward/right while far leg bears weight; expressive high knee.

cells.name: BL opposite contact
cells.observation: Opposite contact depth is inferred from changed overlapping upper thighs and forward visible leg; anatomical assignment less certain than the two passing cells.

cells.name: BR opposite passing
cells.observation: Near leg bears weight while far boot lifts behind/left; visibly differs from TR.

measurementContract.coordinateSpace: Native per-cell pixels from cell top-left; TL/TR/BL/BR order.
measurementContract.rootMeaning: Manual concealed pelvis-center X projected to the independently visible supporting boot sole in each cell. This is a 2D registration pivot, not a certified anatomical pelvis or recovered physical ground.
measurementContract.capMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 minimum Y within independently chosen cap regions that exclude rifles.
measurementContract.referenceMethod: Rounded median of four freshly measured cap-to-individual-supporting-sole spans; one whole-source scale, no per-phase scaling.
measurementContract.sizeLimit: Preserve measured per-cell cap-to-supporting-sole span variation with one whole-source reference height; individual ground registration removes row-layout hover without rescaling phases.

previousSharedRowRegistrationDiagnostic.rootMeaning: Fresh manual pelvis-center X projected to maximum alpha64 visible boot-ground Y shared by each sheet row. Hidden pelvis is an estimate.
previousSharedRowRegistrationDiagnostic.referenceMethod: Median of four cap-to-shared-row-ground spans; one whole-source scale, no per-frame normalization.

measurementContract.groundMethod: Fresh manually selected supporting-boot-only regions, alpha>=64 bottom-exclusive Y in each cell. Individual sole Y replaces prior shared row maximum; pixels and pelvis-X estimates unchanged.

nativePixelEvidence.paddingAssessment: All cells exceed strict 16-pixel floor; top-cell bottom margins and bottom-cell top margins miss 32-pixel generation goal by 1 to 8 pixels. No clipping or cell crossing found.
nativePixelEvidence.coloredRGBAssessment: Residual saturated red/yellow RGB only at alpha1/2/3/4 under stated criterion; no opaque outline blocker established. Native viewer overemphasizes nearly transparent RGB.

limits: Acceptance applies only to exact SHA and four cells inspected.
TR high knee is expressive; this does not establish historically accurate march/drill.
Contact leg-depth assignment is inferred from 2D overlap and remains less certain than passing poses.
No default/production/full-family approval or temporal renderer, turn/cold-resume, residency/performance proof.
registrationAssessment: Individual supporting-sole registration is visually better for foot contact than the previous shared-row estimate. Sole silhouette identification has about 3 native pixels of uncertainty; no physical-ground or temporal-gait certification is implied.
